title: Modeling Behavioral Dynamics in Digital Content Consumption: An Attention-Based Neural Point Process Approach with Applications in Video Games
authors: Junming Yin; Yue Feng; Yong Liu
eligible_reason: Attention-based neural point process for predicting consumer activity sequences in video games. Prediction model, no DiD or event-study design.
design_notes: train.py/evaluate.py/predict.py (PyTorch) on event sequences; replicate.ipynb reproduces Section 4.5 with simulated sequences.
data_files_note: README.md: original data under NDA; 'we generate a simulated dataset data/sim_data.csv with the simulation algorithm listed in Appendix E'.
data_provenance_note: Sequences simulated from the model trained on the original data.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
